svg.title: Three ways to resize a slide
svg.desc: One shared display scale shows an original 720 by 480-point slide and three 600 by 300-point outputs. DoNotScale keeps shape sizes, EnsureFit leaves side margins, and Maximize crops edge shapes.

g.text: Three ways to resize a slide
All four panels use the same scale.
Same shape sizes · bottom and right clipped
Smaller shapes · unused space at both sides
Content fills the width · edge shapes clipped
